quality.sourcePolicy: Rebuilt from retained original source clips, never enlarged from the low-bitrate fallback. Native1080/4K sources and60fps originals are used where retained and traceable; lower-resolution archival footage is upscaled with Lanczos; source frame rates are resampled by selecting/repeating frames. No optical-flow-generated frames or invented archival detail.
quality.runtimeFallback: HLS-only HD delivery; full-resolution review MP4s remain local because they exceed the static host per-file limit.
